name: @stagepilot/desktop
description: Tauri v2 shell for the StagePilot dashboard

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.build:ci: npm run build:runtime && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.ci.conf.json
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:help && npm run build:runtime && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.macos.conf.json && npm run build:mac:finish
scripts.build:mac:ci: npm run build:help && npm run build:runtime && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.macos.ci.conf.json && npm run build:mac:uninstaller
scripts.build:mac:finish: if [ -n "$STAGEPILOT_RELEASE_BUILD" ]; then bash ../scripts/resign_macos_release.sh; else npm run build:mac:uninstaller; fi
scripts.build:mac:uninstaller: for dmg in src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg; do bash ../scripts/inject_macos_uninstaller.sh "$dmg"; done
scripts.build:runtime: npm --prefix ../frontend run build && npm run build:cloudflared
